facts.text: Swarthmore evaluates all first-semester students on a credit/no credit basis, meaning letter grades do not appear on the official transcript.

sources.title: First-Year Experience :: Academics :: Swarthmore College
sources.quote: Swarthmore fosters this freedom with what is essentially a “pass/fail” system for a student's first semester. You're graded, but grades don't go on your transcript—you either get credit or you don't.
